answer:
The two attributes are `context_window` and `num_output`. The docs show them being set on the global `Settings` object:

"Settings.context_window = 4096" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md]

"Settings.num_output = 256" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md]

The section heading and comments describe them as the maximum input size to the LLM (`context_window`) and the number of tokens reserved for text generation (`num_output`). These values are normally set automatically from the LLM's attributes, but they can be overridden.
